decisive_items: Direct immunofluorescence: Positive with granular deposition of IgG, IgA, IgM, C3, C1q, and fibrinogen in the dermal blood vessels
predominant lymphocytic infiltrates in perifollicular and periappendageal regions of the dermis and lobular panniculitis
histopathologic examination: Image C: Scanning view shows predominant lymphocytic infiltrates in perifollicular and periappendageal regions of the dermis and lobular panniculitis
response.rationale: The champion candidate, R2 (Discoid Lupus Erythematosus), is supported by the positive direct immunofluorescence results and the presence of lymphocytic infiltrates in the dermis. The runner-up candidate, R1 (Lichen Planopilaris), is supported by the linear hair loss and dermoscopic findings, but is less likely due to the lack of broken hairs on dermoscopic examination. The counterfactual missing items, such as systemic involvement and positive antinuclear antibody or antidouble-stranded DNA antibody test results, would have strengthened the case for R2, while the absence of broken hairs on dermoscopic examination weakens the case for R1.

rejected.why: lack of specific dermoscopic findings and histopathologic examination results consistent with Morphea
